events.verdict: Muscala (PHI) makes marginal contact with Gordon's (ORL) arm during his shot attempt near the rim.
Fournier (ORL) wraps and dislodges Simmons (PHI), who has established a legal picking position.
Fournier (ORL) makes high-five contact with Embiid's (PHI) hand after he has released the ball.
Muscala (PHI) briefly places a hand on the opposite side of Gordon's (ORL) chest, but the contact is tactile in nature as he immediately corrects himself and slides the hand off.
Vucevic (ORL) is in the path of Muscala (PHI) when he sets a legal pick and absorbs the contact.
Simmons (PHI) and Vucevic (ORL) engage and disengage as Vucevic (ORL) tries to get post position.
Redick (PHI) is in the path of Gordon (ORL) and gives him the necessary one step when setting the legal back screen.
Gordon (ORL) initiates contact by engaging with Simmons (PHI) and affects his ability to get to the basket.
Embiid (PHI) briefly grasps Vucevic's (ORL) jersey, but does not affect his FOM.
Fournier (ORL) gathers the ball after his dribble and lifts his pivot foot after he initially plants it.
Redick (PHI) delivers contact to Augustin (ORL) as he extends both arms into his chest and dislodges him from his legally obtained position.
Vucevic (ORL) is in the path of Embiid (PHI) when he delivers marginal contact with his arm, but does not dislodge Embiid (PHI) or affect his ability to contest the shot.
Redick (PHI) steps out of bounds with his left foot when he receives the pass from Simmons (PHI).
Redick (PHI) and Fournier (ORL) engage and disengage on the inbound play.
Simmons (PHI) commits a take foul on Vucevic (ORL).
